about: The run plan that `qargi flow plan check` reads: one feature and the task nodes that merge into it, written by a person (qargi never prints one; the checker's own document is qargi-run-plan-check). Each node names a role, the paths it may change (`scope`), the command that says it is done (`done`) and the nodes it comes after (`after`). The checker is stricter than this shape: it refuses a key that is not listed here, a role qargi does not know, a scope that is absolute or holds `..`, a `done` that reads as prose, a node id used twice, an `after` that names no node or the node itself, a cycle, and two nodes that are not ordered by `after` and whose scopes can touch the same path. A plan describes work to be done: it grants no approval and starts nothing.
writes: Nothing: the file is written by its author, and the checker only reads it.

project.description: The name of the project, as a stored project has it.

target_feature.description: The open feature the nodes merge into: a lower case slug of at most 40 characters, never master or develop.

nodes.description: At least one and at most 500 task nodes.

id.description: A lower case slug of at most 40 characters, unique in the plan.

task.description: What the node does, in words; not empty.

role.description: A role qargi knows (qargi role list).

scope.description: The paths or globs, relative to the repository root, that the node may change: a directory stands for everything beneath it; no `..`, no absolute path, no space or comma; at least one and at most 100. Declare CHANGELOG.md, man/qargi.1, docs/reference/refusals.md, tests/suite.txt and tests/durations.txt here when the task changes them: a node is never assumed to write them.

done.description: One command line whose exit status says the task is done; its command words are checked as the DONE of a prepared run is.

after.description: The ids of the nodes that must be done first; absent is the same as empty.

review_kind.description: What looks at the result before it merges. The checker only notes a review or an advisor.

profile.description: A profile of the role (qargi agent for ROLE --profile).

runtime.description: The runtime the member of the node runs on.
